messages:
Priya: heads-up — we're proposing a schema change for the rerank response. add `normalized_score` (0..1 float) and mark `score_v1` deprecated. need to discuss routing, quota accounting, telemetry, and console UX before we ship. :eyes:
Alex: what's the motivation? is this strictly a display/normalization change or does runtime routing need the new field?
Priya: mainly normalization for cross-model comparability (so console can do comparisons and thresholds). but model-selection/routing might want signed scores later. we need to decide compatibility rules.
Ben: for quotas: do candidates w/o `normalized_score` still count as full candidate units? we have customers who send sparse scores (only top 5).
Rachel: they should count. charging is per-candidate input not per-scored output for fairness. if we change counting rules we break billing.
Marco: agree with Rachel. count candidates requested in payload. we can add a separate metric `scored_candidates` to show how many got normalized scores.
Priya: proposal: accept both fields during transition. precedence: 1) `signed_score` (if present, use for routing/thresholds), 2) `normalized_score`, 3) legacy `score_v1` fallback. Document clearly.
Alex: routing caveat: some routing policies are cost-based and expect magnitude to map to model confidence. signed vs normalized semantics differ. we need a clear conversion doc and a strict contract for what `signed_score` means (range, polarity).
Priya: draft contract in PR #4321: `signed_score`: float [-1,1], positive means relevance, negative penalize. `normalized_score`: [0,1], monotonic with `signed_score` (e.g., map by (signed+1)/2). legacy `score_v1` arbitrary.
Ben: telemetry: add names `rerank.score.method`, `rerank.scored_candidates.count`, `rerank.fallback_used` (enum: none, normalized, legacy). set sampling to 10% for debug telemetry to start.
Rachel: console impact: need a single canonical column for ranking score and a toggle to show raw fields. rollout UX: non-breaking default shows `normalized_score` where available, otherwise legacy. allow canary flag per-tenant to opt into strict `signed_score` semantics.
Jenny: ops perspective: if we accept both fields we'll need backward-compatible parsers in the runtime. current parser expects `scores[]` aligned with candidates. please add migration tests.
Marco: on model selection: prefer models with affinity metadata if tenant requests `signed_score` semantics. otherwise stick to current cheapest-compatible routing. we also need a fallback path when `signed_score` present but a model doesn't produce it — treat as `fallback_used`.
Priya: here's a proposed payload example to include in the spec:
```json
{"candidates": ["c1","c2","c3"],
 "scores": [{"normalized_score":0.87, "signed_score":0.74}, {"normalized_score":0.12}, {"score_v1": 2.3}]
}
```
Alex: looks good. one nit: enforce array length parity between `candidates` and `scores` — runtime should reject mismatches with 400.
Ben: quota change note: we will NOT change candidate unit counting, but console should expose `scored_candidates.count` so customers can see when scoring sparsity affects their analytics.
Rachel: telemetry dashboards: add a panel showing % of responses using `normalized_score` vs falling back. also a time-series for `rerank.fallback_used` by tenant. add alert if fallback rate > 5% for a tenant over 1h.
OpsBot: deploy reminder — rolling canary scheduled: eng-platform/staging -> 10% prod -> 50% -> 100% (manual gates). use feature flag `rerank.new-score-contract` per-tenant.
Jenny: migration checklist: update parser (#4321), add runtime unit tests, add console toggle, add telemetry metrics and dashboards, add billing note. I'll own the parser PR.
Priya: decision summary: keep backward compat; precedence signed > normalized > legacy; don't change candidate quota counting; add telemetry metrics and dashboard panels; rollout behind per-tenant feature flag; canary rollout plan as OpsBot. action items: Rachel dashboard, Alex doc for conversion rules, Ben telemetry + metrics, Marco routing affinity tweak, Jenny parser tests.
Alex: +1. I'll draft the conversion doc today and link to #4321.
Rachel: I'll prototype the dashboard and share screenshots in next sync. :thumbsup:
Ben: I'll add metrics to the collector and wire up 10% sampling for debug events.
Marco: routing change is small, will add unit tests to ensure fallback metric is emitted.
Priya: thanks team — I'll file the rollout ticket and tag owners. keeping this thread for decisions.
